title: A Comparison of Rapid Immunoassay Tests for the Detection of Ruptured Membranes
brief_summary: Specific objectives include analysis of performance of ROM Plus® in diagnosing ROM, as compared to Amnisure® and the conventional clinical assessment confirmed by a thorough chart review after delivery.
raw_criteria:
PARTICIPANT SELECTION CRITERIA:

Inclusion Criteria:

• Any woman who presents with alleged leakage of amniotic fluid is eligible for recruitment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known placental previa
* Active vaginal bleeding
study_population: Any pregnant woman who presents with alleged leakage of amniotic fluid is eligible for recruitment
condition: Pregnant Woman With Premature Rupture of Amnion Membranes
